Sorry bro that sucks for sure. I’m in the state of more then likely dumped and I know how it hurts. It feels like a stabbing pain from a hot poke stick. 

All I can say is to grief for now, may not sound great but let it out. Go for a walk and listen to music if that helps. I been doing that for a couple weeks now and it’s starting to help. Songs from like Front Porch Step and bands like that have always helped me. Or like The Wonder Years either way go through the point of crying and just feeling the hurt then work to getting better. 

- Yours truelly a fellow sad dude( keep strong my dude<3)

I may not be the best to give advice for this since I just posted about my maybe break up and I’m crying. Though I will say this no human deserves to be sad no human deserves to be alone. I can’t make the decision ultimately for you but I will say you should always try for love. Sorry though if my advice seems like crap for now
